results.title: Senior Director DEI & Talent (REMOTE)
results.description: EnerSys is the global leader in stored energy solutions for industrial applications. We have over thirty manufacturing and assembly plants worldwide servicing over 10,000 customers in more than 100 countries. Worldwide headquarters are located in Reading, PA, USA with regional headquarters in Europe and Asia. We complement our extensive line of Motive Power and Energy Systems with a full range of integrated services and systems. With sales and service locations throughout the world, and over 100 years of battery experience, EnerSys is the power/full solution for stored DC power products. Learn More About Our Company What We’re Offering Paid time off plus paid holidaysMedical/dental/vision insurance planLife insurance, short/long term disability, tuition reimbursement, flex spending, and employee stock purchase plan401K planCulture: We value and strive for excellence in all that we do through innovative technology by creating long lasting relationships with our stakeholders, co-workers, and customers. We continentally strive to foster teamwork, engagement and enhance our employee’s skills and competence by providing appropriate training. Compensation Range: $159,700-$195,000 plus annual bonus Compensation may vary based on applicant's work experience, education level, skill set, and/or location. results.title: Senior Director Human Resources
results.description: Position Overview: Third Plateau, a growing multi-disciplinary social impact consulting firm, is looking for a self-directed professional to serve as a Senior Director of Human Resources on our Operations team. The Senior Director will lead key pieces of the employee lifecycle, such as talent management, employee relations, and compensation and benefits oversight and administration. The Senior Director will work closely with the Chief Operating Officer and Associate Director of Human Resources to ensure our systems and processes are effectively meeting the needs of the larger team while also working efficiently for the Operations team. Top candidates will be highly organized self-starters, able to work under tight deadlines, able to juggle multiple assignments simultaneously, and be hungry to learn. Application Deadline: Rolling, first review beginning May 1, 2024 Start Date: ASAP Location: Remote, with access to office space in the Bay Area. Deep experience supporting a California-based workforce required. Please note that being authorized to work in the U.S. is a precondition of employment at Third Plateau, as we are not able to sponsor applicants for work visas at this time. Starting Annual Salary (Exempt): $130,000 - $160,000 A compensation committee of at least one department head, co-founder, and the COO will meet to discuss potential starting salary within the band by weighing the candidate's expected contribution in terms of previous experience and expertise against current Third Plateau employees. We commit to sharing the reasoning used to determine starting salary with you. The expectation is not for new team members to be hired with a starting salary at the top of the band, but to have a salary that adequately compensates experience and expertise while countering pay inequality and upholding internal parity. Benefits: In addition to collaborating with an incredible team of social impact professionals, benefits include: Health, dental, and vision insuranceRetirement plan with employer matchingUnlimited paid time offWellness programDedicated professional development budgetCell phone and home internet reimbursementHome office stipend WHAT YOU’LL DOThe ideal candidate will maintain knowledge of trends, best practices, regulatory changes, and new technologies, and incorporate this knowledge into the work of the department. Functionally, candidates should bring a track record of refining HR policies and success in building HR systems in a mission-driven startup, or complex and growing organization. The Sr. Director of Human Resources will serve as a member of a team developing and executing HR strategies that align with the organization’s goals and supervising the Associate Director of Human Resources. Essential duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Talent Management (40%)o Lead strategy and execution of implementing the appropriate platforms, systems, policies, internal controls, and operating standards.o Partner in the development of our human capital strategy by working closely with COO, CFO, and department heads.o Design, implement, and regularly update policies and practices that promote equity and belonging throughout the employee lifecycle, ensuring compliance with legal requirements and industry best practices. o Oversee recruiting, hiring, onboarding, and offboarding in partnership with the Associate Director of Human Resources.o Lead annual review and performance management process in partnership with the Associate Director of Human Resources.o Work with external consultants and legal counsel to manage processes and policies, ensure compliance, and mitigate risk for employees living in multiple states across the United States.o Maintain the current employee handbook.o Serve as point of contact for employment verifications and other compliance pieces for personnel.o Ensure labor laws in all states are followed regarding onboarding, leaves of absence, wage & hour, separation & labor law postings Safety & Workers' Comp compliance.o Participate in conversations with department heads on career pathways and staffing. Employee Relations and Engagement (25%)o Authentically engage with equity and belonging policy team to implement programs and initiatives that enhance employee engagement and promote a sense of belonging. o Lead any conflict resolutions as needed in partnership with the management team.o Serve as lead conducting internal investigations and risk assessments, in partnership with legal counsel, to ensure people and processes are compliant and consistent with Third Plateau policies and procedures.o Work in partnership with the key partners of the leadership team (vice presidents, COO, CFO, cofounders) on the execution of employee engagement initiatives.o Monitor and analyze employee feedback to identify areas for improvement and implement responsive initiatives. Compensation/Benefits Oversight and Administration (25%)o Provide compensation and benefits planning and analysis to ensure we are providing a cost effective and comprehensive benefits program that supports recruitment and retention of high-performing staff.o Work with Associate Director of HR to manage relationships with benefits brokers (e.g., FSA/Medical/Workers Comp).o Plan the coordination, administration, and reporting of annual compensation programs including researching market trends to making recommendations for enhancements, improvements, and increased competitiveness.o Lead compensation, promotion, and discretionary bonus processes in partnership with COO, a Third Plateau co-founder, and department heads.o Oversee the execution of the open enrollment processes.o Oversee proper execution of semi-monthly including auditing/approving payrolls and serving as back-up for Associate Director of Human Resources running payroll.o Serve as an administrator on the firm’s 401k plan. Organizational Stewardship (10%)o Tend to internal administrative items (e.g., emails/slack, timekeeping, expenses, HR).o Participate in internal activities (i.e., full team meetings, peer learning communities, culture building activities, and regular check-ins with your supervisor)o Engage in individual and team wide professional development/learning opportunities.o Supervise staff (Associate Director of Human Resources). WHAT YOU’LL NEED o 7-10+ years of professional experience in human resources including time navigating complex and confidential conversations.o Deep experience working for a California-based company.o Experience in building/improving systems, and implementing effective change management for remote, multi-state personnel.o Experience working effectively with partners who are diverse with respect to age, race, ethnicity, gender orientation, socio-economic status, nationality, religion, and culture. o The ability to create authentic relationships and work across internal departments to foster relations, community, and company cohesion.o Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, paired with the ability to be calm and focused when juggling multiple projects and deadlines.o The ability to maintain strict confidentiality regarding payroll, benefits and other sensitive HR information.o Excellent skills in listening, writing, and oral communication.Human resource credentials, such as SHRM or SPHR, are preferred but not required. HOW TO APPLYNot sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Research shows that men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria. Yet, women and other people who are systematically marginalized tend to only apply if they meet every requirement.[1] If you believe that you could excel in this role, we encourage you to apply. We are dedicated to considering a broad array of candidates, including those with diverse workplace experiences and backgrounds. Whether you're new to this field, returning to work after a gap in employment, looking to transition, or take the next step in your career path, we will be glad to have you on our radar. If are you interested in applying, please take some time to review Who We Are and What We Do, and Our Commitment to DEI. After learning about us, submit your cover letter and resume to Lisa Long at Lisa@talentepartners.com. At Third Plateau, we believe in the power of diverse teams. In our recruiting efforts, we always seek to reach a broad and diverse pool of applicants to ensure our final candidates are not a homogenous group in terms of demographics or experience. You can read more about our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) here. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds to apply. Third Plateau is committed to providing equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to their race, color, age, religious creed, sexual orientation, or other personal characteristics.[1] Source: https://hbr.org/2014/08/why-women-dont-apply-for-jobs-unless-theyre-100-qualified

results.title: Human Resources Director
results.description: Insero Talent Solutions is recruiting a Human Resources Director for a fast growing manufacturing company in Ithaca, NY. Overview:As the HR Director, you will be responsible for leading and managing all aspects of the human resources function within our organization. You will play a critical role in developing and implementing HR strategies, policies, and programs to support our business objectives and foster a positive work environment. Reporting directly to the President and CEO, you will serve as a key member of the senior leadership team. Key Responsibilities:Strategic HR Planning: Develop and implement HR strategies aligned with the company's goals and objectives. Collaborate with senior management to identify HR priorities and initiatives. Anticipate and address future HR needs to support organizational growth and change. Talent Acquisition and Management: Oversee the recruitment and selection process to attract and retain top talent. Develop and implement effective onboarding and retention strategies. Ensure fair and equitable compensation and benefits structures. Lead performance management efforts, including goal setting, evaluations, and career development. Employee Relations and Compliance: Provide guidance and support on employee relations issues, ensuring fair and consistent resolution. Ensure compliance with all relevant employment laws and regulations. Develop and enforce company policies and procedures. Promote a culture of diversity, equity, and inclusion throughout the organization. Training and Development: Identify training and development needs and design relevant programs. Oversee employee training initiatives to enhance skills and capabilities. Foster a culture of continuous learning and professional growth.HR Operations and Administration: Manage HR systems and processes, including payroll, benefits administration, and HRIS. Oversee the administration of employee records and documentation. Ensure accuracy and integrity of HR data and reporting. Leadership and Team Management: Lead and develop a high-performing HR team. Provide coaching, mentorship, and feedback to team members. Foster a collaborative and supportive work environment. Qualifications:Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or related field; Master’s degree preferred. 15 years of progressive HR experience, with 5 years in a leadership role. Strong knowledge of employment laws, regulations, and best practices. Demonstrated experience in developing and implementing HR strategies and programs. Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills. Ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization. SHRM or HRCI certification preferred. This job description outlines the key responsibilities and qualifications for the HR Director role. The successful candidate will be a strategic thinker, adept at managing people and processes, and committed to fostering a positive and inclusive workplace culture.

results.title: Sr. HRBP
results.description: The Sr. Human Resources Business Partner (Sr. HRBP) serves as a strategic partner and provides effective HR operational services and advice to business center leaders, managers, and staff to support the delivery of organizational objectives and outcomes. The Sr. HRBP serves as a consultant on all HR-related matters, including performance management, talent development, and employee relations. The Sr. HRBP acts as an employee champion, leadership coach, strategic partner, and change agent. The Sr. HRBP manages and resolves complex employee relations issues, guides on and assists in performance improvement, and conducts related issues. They work closely with management and employees to improve work relationships, build morale, increase productivity and retention. YOU SHOULD HAVE Bachelor’s degree in related field or equivalent, 6 to 8 plus years of related experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience 6+ years of demonstrated success and experience in HR Business Partner or similar role, preferably in a creative industry. 3-5 years managing and resolving complex and high-stake employee relations issues at varying levels within an organization 3-5 years managing performance management systems, cycles and successfully implementing organizational development strategies. International HR experience is preferred SHRM-SCP, SHRM-CP, SPHR or PHR certification a plus but not a requirement ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES Business Partner with business units to integrate people strategies with overall organizational strategy. Provide HR consulting services to Business Units as it relates to human resources programs and policies, often encompassing all areas of human resources. Leverage the HR function to deliver effective and customer-focused HR Operations. Provide policy guidance and interpretation; recommend and implement changes as needed. Analyze trends and metrics in partnership with the HR group to develop solutions, programs, and policies. Provide day-to-day performance management guidance to business line management (e.g., coaching, counseling, career development, disciplinary actions). Gather and analyze relevant data, trends, and patterns and identify gaps and priorities, particularly in the areas of talent management, performance management, workforce planning, strategic recruitment, and capability development. Manage the organization’s global performance management program, including communications, training, and monitoring. Play a key role in ensuring coherent implementation of people plans and processes across the units within their area and ensuring they align with global direction. Coach and challenge leaders to support the development of leadership capability. Interface with various levels within the organization to develop and lead training initiatives on a broad range of HR-related topics. Manage and resolve complex employee relations issues. Conducts effective, thorough and objective investigations. Consult with employees and management on employee relations issues providing guidance and assistance with policy interpretation, open and direct communication, conflict resolution, performance management, and conduct-related issues. Work closely with management and employees to improve work relationships, build morale, and increase productivity and retention. Serve as an initial point of contact for employee relations, including conducting exit interviews. Maintain in-depth knowledge of legal requirements related to day-to-day management of employees, reducing legal risks and ensuring regulatory compliance. Partners with the legal department and outside counsel as needed/required. Research and explain laws and legal affairs concerning employment to managers, supervisors, and employees. Use surveys, interviews, and other studies to research human resource policies, compensation, and other employment issues. After analyzing the information, make recommendations on changes. Advise and train managers and supervisors in best employee relations practices and strategies for managing supervisor problems and employee grievances. COMPETENCIES Risk Management Excellent Communication Managing Performance Strategic Thinking Consultation Proactive and Anticipatory instincts Cultural Awareness. HR & Labor law Expertise Relationship Management Organizational Development Organizing Skills Detail Orientation Time Management Team Orientation Ethics, Integrity, Values

results.title: Director, Human Resources
results.description: About The Role Join a dynamic HR function dedicated to fueling the success of our organization by ensuring our people strategy supports our business strategy. As a Tarsus HR Business Partner, you'll drive talent strategies within the business that propel our mission to focus on unmet needs by applying proven science and new technology to revolutionize treatment for patients, starting with eye care. Let’s talk about some of the key responsibilities of the role: Strategic Business Partnership Be a consultative partner and trusted advisor, working with business leaders across multiple functions to support strategic business objectives and advise and influence on issues including talent acquisition, compensation, benefits, organization design, workforce planning, onboarding, engagement, employee relations, performance management, regulatory compliance, talent development, organizational effectiveness, change management, and other special projects. Incorporate business priorities into the HR plan to ensure alignment with culture and overall business objectives. Manage through influence and help drive accountability throughout the organization. Manage employee relations to enhance workforce performance and engagement, and conduct investigations as needed. Recommend and implement strategies to drive organization performance. Pull through, communication and delivery of talent development and engagement programs to ensure an effective employee experience, development of our people, and success of our business goals. Provide leadership in driving our culture and employee engagement by developing engagement strategies, driving, and fostering the employee value proposition, partnering with leaders to deliver timely and effective communications, and influencing operating mechanisms to ensure alignment with strategic growth plans. Deliver presentations and trainings to leadership and employees to communicate people strategy and programs, and provide people and leadership development. HR Projects Apply sound project management, problem solving and process improvement tools or methodologies to build and execute strategic and tactical plans across a variety of HR programs, processes and systems. Identify, track and report key metrics and performance indicators on HR Strategy related areas to ensure progress and growth against goals and plan. Organize, lead, and coordinate projects and change management, while working with colleagues and/or external consultants regarding project deliverables, roles, resource requirements, timelines and costs. Serve as a subject matter expert on employment-related policy and provide coaching, counselling, and advice to guide leaders and HR team members with regards to HR programs, practices, policies, legislation, investigations and regulatory requirements. Develop, communicate, and implement initiatives and programs that support organizational growth, drive change management and maximize employee engagement. May perform other related duties as required and/or assigned. Factors for Success: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial/Organizational Psychology or other related discipline or equivalent knowledge and experience required. Master’s Degree is a plus. Minimum 12 years of relevant Human Resources experience, including proven success and at least 5 years as a business partner, managing employee relations issues, and knowledge of sound techniques in all aspects of human resource management. Previous pharmaceutical/biotech experience is highly desired. Possess a learning orientation and the ability to work in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment. Capability to be both strategic and tactical with the proven expertise to think, create and execute plans strategically beyond just the tactical execution. Experience in evaluating and implementing tools, process, technology, and infrastructure required to attract, retain, develop talent and grow the organization. Superior written and verbal communication skills that can effectively address all levels within the organization. Must be a skilled presenter capable of creating business case information and influencing change across the organization. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex legal, regulatory, diversity and human resources related documents. Sound project management skills, with the ability to effectively plan, set priorities, and manage several complex projects simultaneously while working under pressure to meet deadlines. Advanced coaching/consulting, conflict resolution and facilitation skills. Innovative mindset, with an ability to develop and implement innovative and creative solutions to both HR programs and business problems that drive an optimal employee experience. Ability to implement and use technology, tools, and processes to stay highly organized and efficient. Must be self-motivated, highly detailed and organized, able to take initiative to make or adapt to changes. Strong computer and systems knowledge, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and experience with HRIS and other HR systems. A Few Other Details Worth Mentioning: The position will be based in our beautiful Irvine office, complete with a courtyard, snacks, drinks, and occasional catered meals. We provide a hybrid work environment. We are passionate about our culture! Our Tarsans live our values of commitment to patients, empowerment to champion innovation, and teamwork to amplify impact!This position reports directly to our Sr Director, HRSome travel may be required – up to 20% At Tarsus, we understand the importance of attracting and retaining top talent. The expected base pay range for this position is $174,000 - $243,600 plus bonus, stock equity, and comprehensive benefits. The base pay range reflects the target range for this position, but individual pay will be determined by additional factors such as job-related skills, experience and relevant education or training. Our benefits include health, dental and vision insurance benefits to ensure your well-being. We believe in work-life balance and offer generous paid time off, including vacation, holidays, and personal days. For more details regarding Tarsus benefits, please visit: https://alliantbenefits.cld.bz/tarsus2024BenSnapshot. Tarsus Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

reasoning.cv_summary: A senior HR leader with 14 years of experience, including roles as HR Director and Senior HR Manager. Holds a Master's in HRM and a CIPD Level 7 certification, with deep expertise in strategic HR functions across the technology and non-profit sectors.

job_explanations.title: Senior Director DEI & Talent (REMOTE)
job_explanations.match_reason: Strong match. The Senior Director level and requirement for 15+ years of experience align well with the candidate's 14 years and prior "HR Director" title. The role's focus on Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development, DEI, and Succession Planning are all explicitly listed skills in the candidate's CV.

job_explanations.title: VP of Human Resources Americas
job_explanations.match_reason: Strong match. This executive role is a logical next step for a candidate with 14 years of experience and an "HR Director" background. The responsibilities, including talent strategy, employee relations, and compliance, are core strengths. The candidate's broad strategic experience makes them a credible fit for a VP position.

job_explanations.title: Senior Director Human Resources
job_explanations.match_reason: Partial match. While the seniority and responsibilities are a strong fit, the job requires "deep experience supporting a California-based workforce." The candidate's CV lists general "Employment Laws" and a current location in Stuttgart, with no specific mention of California compliance expertise, which is a critical requirement for this role.

job_explanations.title: Human Resources Director
job_explanations.match_reason: Strong match. This HR Director role requires 15 years of experience and 5 in leadership, which aligns perfectly with the candidate's 14 years and "HR Director"/"Senior HR Manager" titles. The required skills in strategic HR, talent management, and employee relations are all well-documented in the candidate's profile.

job_explanations.title: Sr. HRBP
job_explanations.match_reason: Poor match. The candidate is significantly overqualified for this Senior HR Business Partner role, which requires 6-8+ years of experience. With 14 years of experience and previous "HR Director" roles, this position represents a major step down in seniority and strategic scope, making it a poor long-term fit.

job_explanations.title: Senior Human Resources Business Partner
job_explanations.match_reason: Poor match. This is a Mid-Senior level HRBP role for which the candidate is overqualified, given their 14 years of experience and "HR Director" title. The seniority mismatch is a primary disqualifier. Additionally, the role is in the Life Sciences industry, which does not align with the candidate's stated experience in Technology and Non-profit.

job_explanations.title: Director, Human Resources
job_explanations.match_reason: Partial match. The Director title and 12+ years of experience requirement are a good fit. However, the role is in a new domain, as "pharmaceutical/biotech experience is highly desired." The candidate's background in Technology and Non-profit represents a significant industry gap for a role where domain knowledge is important.

job_explanations.title: Human Resources Manager
job_explanations.match_reason: Poor match. The candidate is substantially overqualified for this HR Manager position, which requires 5+ years of experience. With 14 years and a background as an HR Director, this role is a significant step down in seniority and would not be a suitable career progression.

job_explanations.title: HR Business Partner
job_explanations.match_reason: Poor match. This HRBP role requires a minimum of 5 years of experience, making the candidate with 14 years and Director-level experience vastly overqualified. The seniority mismatch is a primary disqualifier, despite the industry (cybersecurity/tech) being a good fit.

job_explanations.title: Regional HR Director, Americas
job_explanations.match_reason: Strong match. This Regional HR Director role is an excellent fit, requiring 10+ years of HR experience and 5+ years of leadership. The responsibilities of leading an HRBP team and partnering with senior business leaders align perfectly with the candidate's "HR Director" experience and strategic skills in the tech industry.

reasoning.recommendation: Focus applications on Director-level and above roles to match your seniority. To strengthen your profile for US-based positions, consider pursuing an SHRM certification to complement your CIPD and explicitly add experience with major HRIS/HCM platforms like Workday to your skills.
